decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall be in accordance with those indicated on the plans and application form.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (8016/P1A, received on 25 October 2018, and 7016/P2, 8016/P3, Block Plan, Location Plan and Flood Statement [received on 23 October 2018]) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the walls of the extension and converted garage hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The development shall not be occupied until the existing vehicle access serving the garage at no.16 Pumping Station Road is closed and reinstated so that it cannot be used as an access across the pavement.
description: Erection of a single storey part rear extension to the house and conversion of part of the garage into a habitable room
